title: Sun, Moon and Stars
seo_title: Grade 1 Sun, Moon and Stars Worksheets: Patterns in the Sky
standard_text: Use observations of the sun, moon, and stars to describe patterns that can be predicted.
meta_desc: Free grade 1 science worksheets on the sun, moon and stars (NGSS 1-ESS1-1): sunrise and sunset, moon shapes and star patterns you can predict. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west. The moon changes shape.
body_html:
How to think about it

The sky has patterns.

  • Sun: rises east, high at noon, sets west.
  • Stars: we see them at night.
  • Moon: its shape changes in a pattern.
Example

The sun is low in the east. What time is it?

The sun rises in the east.

Answer: morning

Example

Full moon, half moon, crescent, ... What comes next?

The pattern goes on.

Answer: new moon

Common mistakes

  • Thinking stars go away in the day.
  • Thinking the sun sets in the east.
  • Thinking the moon is only out at night.
